امتطيتن (form VIII)
# اِمْتَطَيْتُنَّ (imtaṭaytunna) /im.ta.tˤaj.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِمْتَطَى (imtaṭā)
# اُمْتُطِيتُنَّ (umtuṭītunna) /um.tu.tˤiː.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِمْتَطَى (imtaṭā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
